redraft-ppr-8-team.limitation: Normal one-QB mock drafts understate quarterback scarcity for Mighty Giants.

redraft-2qb-10-team.limitation: Ten teams and source-default scoring are not the actual six-team Full-PPR league.

source_rank.usage: Original position in the complete provider player array, including source-only DEF/PK entries.

Rank.usage: Deterministic offensive-player ranking and list-length-aware percentile input.

normalized_position_scope.reason: Mighty Giants does not roster DEF or PK and offensive cross-source percentiles should not be distorted by those positions.

expert_adp_gap.definition: FantasyPros Redraft percentile minus matching FFC ADP percentile on a scale where higher is better.
expert_adp_gap.positive_interpretation: Experts rank the player relatively higher than the observed mock-draft market.

market_adp_gap.definition: FantasyCalc Redraft percentile minus matching FFC ADP percentile on a scale where higher is better.
market_adp_gap.positive_interpretation: Observed trade-market value is relatively stronger than mock-draft cost.

qb_format_gap.definition: FFC 2-QB percentile minus FFC PPR percentile.
qb_format_gap.warning: This is not a pure quarterback effect because team count and source scoring context also differ.

league_adjustments: Apply six-team replacement-level context after reading the eight-team PPR and ten-team 2-QB source formats.
Use the 2-QB feed primarily to understand quarterback scarcity.
Use the PPR feed primarily to understand small-league Full-PPR draft cost.
Apply additional scarcity for two fixed tight-end starters separately.
Do not turn ADP into an automatic draft, waiver or trade recommendation.
limitations: The public API does not expose one format combining six teams, Full PPR, two quarterbacks and two tight ends.
Mock-draft participants and sample sizes may not represent the Mighty Giants league.
ADP describes acquisition cost, not expected points or dynasty trade value.
NFL teams, player identities and optional fields can change without a published API schema version.
The source documents daily updates but its public API documentation is older than the current 2026 data pages.
